agent_data_note: Use RouthSearch AE at `dataset_candidate/routhsearch-issta2025/` (routh_search/ + evaluation_script/ + ardupilot_default_data/).
benchmark_rules: Artifact is at `dataset_candidate/routhsearch-issta2025/` (workspace symlink; use for ls/read_file and $ROUTHSEARCH_HOME).
Primary inputs: routh_search/ (flight tasks + oracles), evaluation_script/ (boundary search shells), ardupilot_default_data/, sample oracle_logs under routh_search/*/oracle_logs/.
Ground-truth PID validity benchmark is constructable (~7000 CPU hours) and is NOT pre-packaged; do not invent GT labels.
Forbidden: fabricating Hit Rate / Miss Rate / misconfiguration counts.
Follow the paper evaluation protocol (flight modes, discovery budget, and subjects) as stated in the task.
non_goals: Using toy 1D PID ranges as the sole multi-dimensional evaluation evidence
Fabricating ground-truth or discovery-campaign results that were not executed
Requiring real UAV hardware or GPU
